name: Perturbed self-attention weak branch (megapack: PAG, SEG, temperature, attention skip)
plain: Runs one extra pass on the positive prompt with chosen self-attention blocks perturbed: identity attention (PAG), Gaussian-blurred queries (SEG), queries divided by a temperature, or the self-attention sublayer's output set to zero (the attention form of STG's layer skip). In add mode the result of the mix rule is pushed away from that pass; in replace mode the perturbed pass takes the unconditional's place in the mix rule and the text-unconditional pass is dropped. On Anima/Cosmos DiTs only SEG and skip are allowed, mapped onto ranges of the DiT's depth. CFGP_STG is the paper preset of the skip method (scale 1, add mode); later megapack stages (where, correct, govern) still act on the result.
math:
Symbols: x̂_c, x̂_u conditional/unconditional x0; x̂_p the perturbed pass on the positive prompt; s scale; B chosen blocks; mix(·,·;w) the active mix rule.
x̂_p = D(x; c) with attn1 in B changed: pag → output = V; seg → attention(blur_σ(Q), K, V), σ ≥ 100 means Q ← mean Q; temperature → attention(Q/T, K, V); skip → attn1 output ← 0.
add: x̂ = mix(x̂_c, x̂_u; w) + s·(x̂_c − x̂_p)
replace: x̂ = mix(x̂_c, x̂_p; w), uncond pass skipped (unless a probe is attached).

props.extra_model_calls: +1 per step (replace mode: the uncond pass is dropped, so net 0)
props.params: method=pag, scale=3, mode=add on top of CFG, blocks=middle, blur_sigma=10, temperature=2; STG preset: method=skip, scale=1, blocks=middle

evidence.symbol: if weak and x0_w is not None
